messages:
marta_cs: Heads-up — Acme Health filed an escalation: after rotating SSO provisioned keys they get 403 on both /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Customer says other orgs unaffected.

acme_ops: Example response we get: HTTP 403
{
  "error": "insufficient_scope",
  "missing": ["generation", "embeddings"]
}
They ran the same client against a portal-created key and it works.

ryan_se: can you paste the exact curl you used to repro? also need org id + svc key id.

acme_ops: repro:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN_FROM_SSO>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-large","prompt":"hello"}'
```
response: the 403 above.
Org: acme-health-345, svc key id: svc-9098.

provisioner-bot: Provision event recorded: request_id=654321, source=okta-scim, mapped_scopes=[embeddings.read,rerank.read], created_at=2026-02-12T15:02:11Z 

tess_sre: quick triage: provisioning log shows SCIM sync only granted embeddings and rerank. Generation scope never added. if portal key works, SSO flow likely dropped the generation mapping.

ryan_se: i checked audit for svc-9098 — SCIM sync rule matched group "inference-prod" but the parser code has a regex that strips tokens with hyphens, so group->scope mapping for names with '-' produces an empty match. filing INFRA-3129.

marta_cs: confirmed workaround from customer: they re-created the Okta group without a hyphen (inferenceprod) then re-provisioned and generation scope appeared.

jenna_support: I generated a temporary portal key for them (ttl 4h) so they could continue while we fix the mapping. Customer verified: portal key success -> both embeddings + generate OK.

acme_ops: temp key helped, thanks. Can you also confirm whether rerank was affected? We saw rerank present in claims, only generation and embeddings were missing.

tess_sre: rerank mapped fine. root cause is the SCIM-to-scope parser incorrectly tokenizes group names containing non-alphabetic chars. We'll push a patch in the sync service to accept hyphens; patch planned for next deploy. INFRA-3129 assigned to @ryan_se.

ryan_se: repro steps for eng: 1) create SCIM group named "inference-prod" in Okta. 2) map the group in the SSO app to portal role with generation + embeddings. 3) trigger SCIM sync -> observe token scp claim missing generation. Quick check code: regex `/([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)/g` fails on names with '-'. Fix: include '-' in class.

marta_cs: i've updated the customer that we have a workaround and an internal ticket. They want ETA for permanent fix.

tess_sre: ETA: patch merged to staging today, prod deploy early next week. i'll update INC-2026-912 with the deploy schedule.

marta_cs: resolving with customer for now, will reopen if issues recur. thanks team. :thumbsup:
